Same mechanism as the hard_stop early-stop: agent_loop.py computes severity_of_turn_text each turn and monitors consecutive meltdown-severity turns, halting at patience threshold. The monitoring signal is compared (sev>=MELTDOWN_THRESHOLD) and acted on (break).
spec_features.notes: Monitoring is heuristic (keyword scorer) not the actual LLM judge, but it executes and changes execution.
